frozen_by: PREREG A42, 2026-11-11; changed only by a dated amendment and never after a number has been seen (S71)
rule: at the first book-tape row whose lead to expiry is at least 300 s and at most 900 s and at which the favorite (the side whose book mid is higher; YES if equal) has a best bid of at least 0.5 and a best ask above that bid plus one tick: a paper bid of ceil(11 / p) whole contracts on the favorite at p = best bid + 0.00001, resting until expiry; one call per market

parameter.side_of_the_book: the bid, one tick inside the best bid — one variable against L2F_favorite, which takes the ask

fill: FILLED only by a trade print strictly after the call and before expiry that trades through the bid: YES bid — a print on the YES coin with side A below p; NO bid — a print on the YES coin with side B above 1 - p; a quote is never a fill (A42 R180)
print: SETTLED_CALLS.md 3b: the tape of record's mid at the market's expiry (first row at/after within 60 s) against the threshold
payoff: FILLED and RIGHT: (1 - p) / p per USD; FILLED and WRONG: -1; UNFILLED: nothing, counted
bench: after five full tape days: a candidate for the next rung only if the payoff sum is above zero and above the control's with at least 20 FILLED and resolved calls; otherwise RETIRED by this rule (A42 R181)
next_rung: one live resting order at the venue's minimum, by its own amendment, after A41 R175's three acts; nothing in this leg sends an order
not_modelled: the paper bid's own effect on the book, partial fills, the maker's fee
